To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

I hereby request an excel/CSV extraction regarding discrimination case rulings related to the Boston Police Department from your electronic database from January 2020-date requested with the following fields:
Case number
Case type
Date Received
Title/Rank of Officer
First and Last Name of Officer
Officer ID/Badge Number
Summary/Narrative of Case
Allegation
Ruling
Finding/Completion Date
Action Taken (ie suspension)
Days/Hours Suspended

I understand that you are not required to create a new public record to comply with my request, see, e.g., ch. 66, §6A(d), however, extraction of data from a database or electronic record system does not constitute creating a new record. See Att’y Gen. v. Dist. Att’y for Plymouth Dist., 484 Mass. 260, 275 (2020) (“[W]here public records are in electronic form, . . . a public records request that requires a government entity to search its electronic database to extract requested data does not mean that the extracted data constitute the creation of a new record under the public records law.”); see also 950 Mass. Code Regs. 32.07(1)(f).

Please produce the records in an electronically-accessible format, including for screen readers, excel, or CSV. See 950 Mass. Code. Regs. 32.04(5)(d). Files that are not accessible to screen readers include, for example, .pdf files or physical documents.

I also request that, if appropriate, fees be waived as we believe this request is in the public interest, as suggested but not stipulated by the recommendations of the Massachusetts Supervisor of Public Records. The requested documents will be made available to the general public free of charge as part of the public information service at MuckRock.com, and is not made for commercial usage.

I expect the request to be filled in an accessible format, including for screen readers, which provide text-to-speech for persons unable to read print. Files that are not accessible to screen readers include, for example, .pdf image files as well as physical documents.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

ada sussman

title: Final Disposition and Aspen Incident No. 2257153 (May 20, 2022–Present)

communications.subject: Illinois Freedom of Information Act. Request: Final Disposition and Aspen Incident No. 2257153 (May 20, 2022–Present)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Illinois Freedom of Information Act., I hereby request the following records:

I request records dated from May 20, 2022 through the date of your search and response concerning the complaint reported by Nichole Allen on or about May 27, 2022 and its association with Aspen Incident No. 2257153.

For purposes of this request, "disposition" includes any finding, determination, conclusion, resolution, closure decision, administrative outcome, status designation, screening decision, referral decision, or other action reflecting how CPS ultimately handled the complaint.

Please produce:

1. Final Disposition Records

Any investigative report, investigative summary, finding, conclusion, determination, recommendation, disposition, closure record, administrative review, or final outcome record relating to the complaint associated with Aspen Incident No. 2257153.

Any records identifying:

A. the allegations reviewed;
B. the findings reached;
C. the final disposition;
D. the date of closure; and
E. the individual(s) responsible for the final determination.

Any records reflecting that:

A. no investigation was conducted;
B. no findings were made;
C. no disposition was issued; or
D. no closure record was created.

Any record reflecting the final administrative disposition of the complaint, regardless of title, including records reflecting that no disposition or determination was made.

2. Aspen Incident No. 2257153

A. A complete copy of Aspen Incident No. 2257153 as it existed at final disposition or closure, including all narratives, classifications, status fields, disposition fields, closure fields, School-Wide Response entries, witness statements, attachments, supporting documents, and related records.

B. All versions of Aspen Incident No. 2257153, including original, amended, revised, superseded, archived, and final versions.

C. All audit logs, metadata, revision histories, activity logs, change histories, status histories, and system-generated records relating to Incident No. 2257153.

3. All records identifying:

A. who created;
B. edited;
C. modified;
D. eviewed;
F. approved; or
G. closed

Incident No. 2257153, including the date and time of each action.

All records reflecting, documenting, supporting, authorizing, approving, or resulting in the classification of Incident No. 2257153 as an Event Reason of "Discipline."

Any records identifying the disposition code, closure code, resolution category, administrative outcome, or final status assigned to Incident No. 2257153.

3. June 3, 2022 Communications

A. Any records reflecting whether CPS considers the June 3, 2022 emails, School-Wide Response, or Aspen Incident No. 2257153 to constitute the final disposition of the complaint.

B. If CPS contends that the June 3, 2022 communications and/or Aspen Incident No. 2257153 constitute the final disposition of the complaint, please identify the records supporting that determination.

4. Certification of Final Version

If CPS contends that any produced copy of Aspen Incident No. 2257153 is the final version, please certify:

A. that it is the final version;
B. the date it became final;
C. whether modifications were made after June 3, 2022;
D. whether prior versions existed; and
E. whether the produced version is a complete and accurate copy of the final Aspen record relied upon by CPS.

5 If no final disposition record, closure record, investigative conclusion, or administrative outcome record exists, please expressly state that no such record exists.

6. No-Records Certification

If no responsive records exist, please provide a written certification identifying:

A. the offices, custodians, systems, and databases searched;
B. the date range searched;
C. whether responsive records ever existed;
D. whether any responsive records were destroyed, deleted, overwritten, archived, migrated, or purged; and
E. the records-retention schedule governing the requested records.

6. Preservation Notice

A. Because these records may be relevant to administrative, civil-rights, employment, student-protection, special-education, or other proceedings, CPS is requested to take reasonable steps to preserve potentially responsive records pending completion of this request.

B. This includes Aspen records, audit logs, metadata, revision histories, emails, Teams messages, witness statements, uploaded documents, EOCO records, Office of Student Protections records, Safety and Security records, Network records, archived records, and backup records relating to Aspen Incident No. 2257153 or the complaint reported on or about May 27, 2022.


7. If any portion of this request is denied, please identify the records withheld, the statutory exemption relied upon, the factual basis for the denial, and the name and title of the person responsible for the denial as required by 5 ILCS 140/9.

Respectfully,

TINA PEARSON

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Tina Pearson
